newsitem.title: ITALY: Alitalia, LOT to cooperate on flights.
newsitem.headline: Alitalia, LOT to cooperate on flights.

text.p: Italian state airline Alitalia has signed a collaboration agreement with Polish carrier LOT for connections between Italy and Poland, Alitalia said in a statement.

The agreement takes effect from March 30 and envisages daily code-sharing flights between Warsaw and Rome and between Warsaw and Milan. LOT will also run two flights to Rome and one to Milan via Krakow.

"The agreement...offers the clients of the two carriers a greater number of connections between Italy and Poland, giving them the opportunity of taking advantage of more connections with flights to other destinations," the statement said.
